items.t: High-voltage battery cells can short internally (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Battery pack can short circuit when fully charged (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Loose bolts inside the battery junction box (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Truck may not lock into Park (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer
items.note: Usually done as an over-the-air update.

items.t: Front upper ball joint nut may be loose (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Front brake hose can rub the tire and leak (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Stability control may not turn on (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Rear lightbar leaks and reverse lights fail (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Weak or no cabin heat and defrost (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Low tire pressure warning may not light up (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Weak 12V battery causes strange warnings or no start
items.job: Test and replace 12V battery
items.note: Often covered under warranty on newer trucks.

items.t: High-voltage battery warning or Stop Safely Now message
items.job: High-voltage battery system diagnosis and software update
items.note: Usually covered by the 8-year/100,000-mile EV component warranty. Out of warranty, battery module repairs cost far more.

items.t: Stops charging on a home charger
items.job: Charging system diagnosis and software update

items.t: DC fast charging sessions fail
items.job: Charging software update

items.t: Will not charge to 100% after battery balancing
items.job: Battery software check

items.t: Powertrain overheating warning with code P0A3C
items.job: Bulletin repair and coolant check

items.t: Front trunk (frunk) will not power open or close
items.job: Frunk software update or latch/actuator repair

items.t: Cabin preconditioning does not run
items.job: Module software update

items.t: Range estimate lower than expected after charging
items.job: Bulletin software update

items.t: ABS and traction control warning lights come on
items.job: ABS diagnosis and bulletin repair

items.t: Heated steering wheel stops working after remote start
items.job: Steering column module software update

items.t: Power tailgate not closed warning
items.job: Tailgate latch or sensor replacement
items.note: RepairPal lists a tailgate lock cylinder at about $384-$424.
